Product $12$ is right but the sum is $-13$, not $-7$.

questions.solution_text:
$A(x + 2) + B(x + 5) \equiv 4x + 17$
$(A + B)x + (2A + 5B) \equiv 4x + 17$
$A + B = 4$
$2A + 5B = 17$
Subtracting twice the first from the second gives $3B = 9$, so $B = 3$ and $A = 1$.

Solved $q + r = -5$ by adding $q$ instead of subtracting it, giving $r = -5 + 3 = -2$.
